mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals supply chain disruptions or a significant slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances when INDPRO drops > 2% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% YoY) combined with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals a deflationary risk and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real yields fall and risk appetite increases.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth < 1% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increasing by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as related industries benefit from increased activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong supply-side response to demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.
